posts.title: Configuration Changes Need a Rollout Protocol
posts.description: Publish validated immutable snapshots, preserve one version within each request, and treat fleet adoption and rollback as observable state transitions.

posts.title: Circuit Breakers Need a Recovery Probe
posts.description: Limit calls to a failing dependency while making recovery bounded, observable, and resistant to late results from earlier attempts.

posts.title: Pagination Needs a Consistency Contract
posts.description: Use a stable keyset cursor for traversal, then choose explicitly whether clients are reading a moving feed or a reproducible snapshot.
